evals.prompt: Simplify this verified change. Policy is duplicated across two owners and callers must know both execution orders.
evals.expected_output: Identifies the concrete duplicated-authority and caller-knowledge costs, applies a bounded behavior-preserving structural improvement when equivalence is provable, and verifies the complete result.

evals.prompt: Simplify this verified change. The code is clear and behavior is covered; I merely prefer a different naming and abstraction style.
evals.expected_output: Finds no consequence-backed simplification, leaves the code unchanged, reports a successful no-op, and does not use preference or line count as evidence.

evals.prompt: Clean up the implementation I just finished. The changed regions are in a large module, and another file contains unrelated unfinished edits. I will run code review afterward.
evals.expected_output: Inspects the changed regions and necessary context, simplifies useful in-scope candidates, preserves unrelated edits, verifies cleanup regressions, and stops with review as the next step without running it.

evals.prompt: Simplify this local mechanical cleanup. Existing type checks cover the affected code; one other candidate changes side-effect ordering and cannot be verified within this task.
evals.expected_output: Uses direct comparison and relevant static checks for the mechanical candidate, skips the unsupported ordering candidate, and reports the remaining uncertainty without broadening into an audit.

evals.prompt: Simplify the finished change, then review the complete diff. The ns-code-review companion is not installed.
evals.expected_output: Verifies the simplification, then performs the already-authorized complete-diff review directly without requiring the optional companion or asking for repeated permission. Does not commit or publish.

evals.prompt: Simplify the substantive code in this explicitly selected file. There is no git diff, and the only useful cleanup is a redundant local variable.
evals.expected_output: Inspects the selected file, applies the bounded behavior-preserving cleanup if evidence supports it, verifies the result, and hands off to review.
